November 21, 41.

Dear Sir,

In reply to your letters dated November 18
and November 19, 1941, I forward herewith a copy of
a Police report regarding Daniel Loewenthal and
eleven other persons.

Yours faithfully,

W. Duncan
Assistant Commissioner
(Special Branch).

Immigration Officer,
American Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Original sent 21-11-41
